summary: INPUT-OWNERSHIP-001 is corrected end-to-end in the exact current input driver. All input-mode dispatch routes use the per-message live launched-PID fence; unchanged hover guard and bounded identical-request publisher verify. Fresh native evidence is exact to this driver and unchanged build-36 runtime/candidate.
scope: Focused verification-tool correction re-review only. No new Core/renderer approval, human acceptance, task closure or Phase5 authorization.

resolvedFinding.dispatchContract: For every individual mouse move/down/up, key down/up, and WM_CHAR: process.poll() must be None, GetWindowThreadProcessId(HWND) must equal the launched process.pid, process.poll() must still be None, then and only then PostMessageW.
coverage: quantity focus, End and Backspace down/up, quantity characters
search focus and every search character
resolvedFinding.bypassAudit: Exactly two direct PostMessageW call sites remain: _NativeWindowBackend.post at line 104 and separately fenced verify_hover.owned_message at line 198. No input-mode raw-post, old global message/key helper, post_click import/use, foreground-input or cursor API remains in the tilt driver. Legacy post_click remains unchanged in its unrelated legacy module but is neither imported nor called here.
resolvedFinding.nativeBinding: The input path creates native = OwnedWindowInput(process) immediately after launch(input), before discovering the HWND; it remains bound to that launched process. Reopen is automatic native regression and sends no Python-driven input.
resolvedFinding.independentProof: Exact AST-extracted current sender rejects stale/dead owners without posting. Death between owner query and second poll also posts zero. Owner changes after move or after button-down permit only the already-valid earlier posts and suppress every subsequent click message. Key-up and character rejection also verified.
resolvedFinding.hoverGuard: Original hover owned_message still checks current HWND owner == launched PID and process.poll() is None before each post. Exact extracted guard and mocked WinDLL stale/dead rejection pass; fresh three-resolution native logs retain 139 messages and 139 unique passing ownership checks per run.

requestPublication.verified: The caller increments seq once and writes the complete work file once. publish_request retries only os.replace on the same work/destination; it cannot increment sequence or reissue the action. Up to 101 attempts, only Winerrors 5/32/33 retry, with 100 maximum sleeps of 0.01 seconds. The 101st failure or any unrelated OSError propagates unchanged. On persistent failure both complete work bytes and previous destination bytes remain intact. A successful replace is not an acknowledgement: caller separately waits for exactly sequence == seq, with captured JSON/PNG checks for capture actions.
requestPublication.independentTests: All allowed Winerrors tested both transient and persistent; Winerrors 2/87 and missing winerror propagate on the first call. Exact nested request tested sequence 101 with three identical publication payloads, one exact-sequence wait, and explicit rejection of sequence 100/102.
requestPublication.historicalRaceEvidence: Retained parent-tilt-owned-hover-720-45 failed with PermissionError(13, Access is denied); original request remains sequence 1 and complete .writing remains sequence 2. Historical failure is retained, not relabeled as success.

gaps.detail: Retry count/backoff is bounded, not a guaranteed wall-clock deadline or universal Windows sharing cure. A long lock, real ACL denial (also Winerror 5), unrelated I/O failure, process exit or acknowledgement timeout still fails the verification. Fresh native passes do not prove a sharing collision occurred or a retry was used in those runs; mocked contention proves retry semantics separately.

Reviewer did not launch a player or deliberately recycle a real HWND/kill a real player during input. Adversarial rejection proof is offline exact-source execution; actual native operation is the separate frozen six-run evidence. Input54 has no per-message ownership telemetry, so exact pinned path coverage plus native state/PNG acknowledgements establishes integration, not a newly observed native stale-owner incident.

Ownership/liveness checks and Win32 PostMessageW are separate calls; this is the requested per-message best-effort fence, not an atomic OS reservation of HWND ownership. No remaining unchecked caller/bypass was found.

No human tilt/reflection/feel acceptance is granted. Prior nonblocking optical-causality, hidden/empty-observation freeze and DPI/platform coverage limits remain. Surface/integration review is not reopened or expanded. Parent documentation still needs its planned final-label update; historical failures and other user passes remain unchanged.
